brand.description: MyPillSafe is a medication-safety assistant for seniors and Canadians with language barriers. It reads your prescription, verifies your pills from a photo, and answers medication questions in your language — and when it isn't sure, it says so.
brand.principle: Built to warn, designed to abstain, never to guess.

tips.routine: Take medications at the same time each day to build a routine.
tips.crush: Never crush or split pills without asking your pharmacist first.
tips.list: Keep an updated medication list with you at all times.
